name: tract_developer_save_record
description: Test 19, bytes laid out by hand from the section 6 table (little-endian). Index 1, years since 2, singleStyle true, styles {0x2000, 0x2001, 0x2002, 0x2003}, years between 5 -> 35 bytes: version 3 (u16), 1 (i32), 2 (i32), 01 (u8), count 4 (u32), the four styles (u32), 5 (i32). The record loads into a new instance and saves back to the same bytes. A version-1 record (version, index 2, years since 7) sets singleStyle true and styles {0x2000, 0x2001, 0x2002} and keeps yearsBetween (5); a version-2 record (flag 0, two styles 0x3000, 0x3001) keeps yearsBetween. Version 4 is rejected with no change. Truncated records return false; fields read before the failure are stored ([choice] for the count: a failed count read resizes to 0, the original uses an uninitialised local). A short style list is zero-filled to the count (count 3, one style -> {0x2000, 0, 0}). A loaded empty style list is filled from the tuning by Init (shipped {0x2000..0x2003}) and the index is clamped to 0; a loaded yearsBetween of 0 becomes the tuning's 5 in Init.
